rows.definition: The multi-wave debt-retirement CAMPAIGN plan `debtlane.WavePlan` (internal/debtlane/wave.go), produced by `PlanWaves`: it partitions debt lanes into ordered, collision-free, concurrent-safe waves and reports total waves, planned lanes and projected grade.
rows.distinction: The whole CAMPAIGN plan for retiring debt in waves - NOT the per-issue execution plan `dispatchWaveExecutionPlan` (one wave's ready rows) and NOT the umbrella `plan` domain.

rows.definition: The wave-partitioning function `PlanWaves` (internal/debtlane/wave.go: `PlanWaves(report Report, opts WavePlanOptions) WavePlan`; internal/issueorchestrator/wave.go: `PlanWaves(issues []Issue, opts WavePlanOptions) Plan`) that orders candidate work into collision-free, concurrent-safe waves under a `WavePlanOptions` config.
rows.distinction: The FUNCTION that partitions work into ordered waves - NOT the produced `WavePlan` campaign plan (its output) and NOT the `WavePlanOptions` config it consumes.
